Think — Understand your request using an LLM (Large Language Model) Decide — Choose the right tool or action to take Act — Execute the action (search, calculate, code, respond) Learn — Remember context from previous interactions What is LangChain? Your LLM (OpenAI, Google Gemini, Llama, etc.) Your data (documents, databases, APIs) Your tools (search engines, calculators, code executors) Why LangChain?
